description: Compare two n8n executions (possibly from different workflows): pick workflow → execution on each side, then compare node durations and Langfuse TTFT/tokens. Part of Overview / Traces / Evaluations / Experiment tabs.

panels.description: Click a workflow to set Workflow A. Then pick an execution on the right.
panels.title: A · Workflows

panels.description: Distinct executions for Workflow A. One row per Execution ID (parallel Tempo traces collapsed). Click Execution ID to select.
panels.title: A · Executions: ${workflowA}

panels.description: Click a workflow to set Workflow B. Then pick an execution on the right.
panels.title: B · Workflows

panels.description: Distinct executions for Workflow B. One row per Execution ID (parallel Tempo traces collapsed). Click Execution ID to select.
panels.title: B · Executions: ${workflowB}

panels.description: node.execute children of the workflow.execute span for this Execution ID. (Node spans do not carry n8n.execution.id — filter via parent >> child.) If empty, check Trace detail for node spans, and that N8N_OTEL_TRACES_INCLUDE_NODE_SPANS is not false. Span limit (spss) is raised so early nodes (e.g. Chat Trigger) are included; table pagination is client-side.

targets.query: { name = "workflow.execute" && span.n8n.execution.id = "${executionIdA}" } >> { name = "node.execute" } | select(span.n8n.node.name, span.n8n.node.type, status, statusMessage)

panels.title: A · Nodes: ${executionIdA} (${workflowA})

panels.description: node.execute children of the workflow.execute span for this Execution ID. (Node spans do not carry n8n.execution.id — filter via parent >> child.) If empty, check Trace detail for node spans, and that N8N_OTEL_TRACES_INCLUDE_NODE_SPANS is not false. Span limit (spss) is raised so early nodes (e.g. Chat Trigger) are included; table pagination is client-side.

targets.query: { name = "workflow.execute" && span.n8n.execution.id = "${executionIdB}" } >> { name = "node.execute" } | select(span.n8n.node.name, span.n8n.node.type, status, statusMessage)

panels.title: B · Nodes: ${executionIdB} (${workflowB})

panels.description: TTFT / tokens from langfuse-exporter for Execution A. Filtered by Project + Execution ID (workflow filter optional per side).
panels.title: A · Execution Statistic (${executionIdA})

panels.description: TTFT / tokens from langfuse-exporter for Execution B. Filtered by Project + Execution ID (workflow filter optional per side).
panels.title: B · Execution Statistic (${executionIdB})
